messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty escalation fired for service `hosted-inference` (P1) — primary on-call did not ack within 5m, now paging secondary (Priya K) and manager (Jamie C). Incident link: https://pd.example/INC12345

Priya K: on it, coming online in ~2m. pulling logs now.

Jamie C: heading to bridge if needed. quick ask — any obvious traffic spike?

Marc L: metrics show a sudden spike in 99th latency starting 12:02 UTC, worker GPU OOMs spiking.

Sam O: I see repeated ``OOM while allocating tensor`` in logs for model-serve-3. Likely bad batch config after the last rollout.

Leah M: Confirmed: recent config change (auto-batch-size=256) rolled 10m ago. That might be the culprit.

Priya K: Acked the PD page. :white_check_mark: Diving into the rollout details. Which config file?

Sam O: repo: infra/serving/configs/batching.yaml — PR #4823 changed default to 256.

Priya K: thanks. Rolling back batch-size to 64 on the affected pool now. Command:

```
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/model-serve-3
kubectl -n redwood set env deploy/model-serve-3 BATCH_SIZE=64
```

Marc L: I'm throttling new traffic to hosted-inference (route -> canary) to reduce pressure. Applying temporary traffic-split.

Dan R: Applied 80/20 (stable/canary) traffic split via gateway. Also scaled model-serve-3 replicas from 4 -> 8 as stopgap.

incident-bot: Action log: Priya K rolled back env BATCH_SIZE on model-serve-3; gateway split updated by Marc L; scale action by Dan R.

Priya K: After rollback, OOMs dropped immediately on node logs. CPU still high but stable. Latency 99p trending down from 3.8s -> 1.1s over the last 3min.

Leah M: Any customer-facing errors? SRE alert shows increase in 502s around 12:04. Could be retries.

Sam O: Looking at edge logs — there were ~1.2k failed requests during the spike, most retried successfully. Suggest we open a customer-impact note.

Jamie C: Agreed. Priya, can you draft the initial impact blurb? I'll review and publish to status.

Priya K: Drafting now: "We experienced elevated latency and request errors for hosted inference customers between 12:01–12:10 UTC due to a batching config regression. Automatic rollback and scaling mitigations applied; error rates returned to normal by 12:07 UTC. Customers may have seen transient 5xx errors; no data loss reported."

Marc L: +1. Add that root cause is a config change in infra repo and that we've reverted the change and will follow up with a postmortem.

Priya K: Updated draft and posted to status.redwood.com (pending Jamie approval).

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Primary ack received? No. Secondary ack by Priya K at 12:05 UTC. Manager notify (Jamie C) also alerted.

Jamie C: Publishing status now. Also creating incident channel #incident-hosted-inference-707777 for long form.

Leah M: We should capture action items: 1) revert unsafe default in batching.yaml (owner: Sam), 2) add rollout guard for batch-size > 128 (owner: Marc), 3) add smoke test verifying OOMs on canary (owner: Dan).

Sam O: I'll open the revert PR and link it to the incident. PR #4830 in progress.

Dan R: I'll add the smoke test in infra-ci and block rollout until smoke passes.

Priya K: Quick note — customer impact list: a subset of hosted inference customers may have experienced transient failed requests and higher latency; we'll surface a targeted list from logs and notify CS.

Jamie C: Great. timeframe: incident declared 12:03, mitigated 12:07, declared resolved for customers at 12:15 after extra monitoring. Leave incident open for postmortem.

Marc L: Reaction :thumbsup: — good catch on the batching default. Also recommend we add a Page Duty escalation tweak: if secondary acks, don't escalate to manager unless duration > 10m. Too many manager pages for config flaps.

Leah M: Noted. I'll open a PD policy tweak ticket.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation status: resolved by manual mitigation. Incident channel #incident-hosted-inference-707777 created. Add follow-up owners to postmortem.

Priya K: Closing loop — I'll coordinate postmortem write-up and send to eng-all. Thanks for quick responses.

Jamie C: Thanks team. If anything else, post in channel.

Dan R: FYI — saved heap profiles and OOM traces to /srv/incident/707777/ for PM analysis.

Marc L: Closing timeline note: primary didn't ack due to mobile DND; PD chain fires properly but we should add secondary contact redundancies.

pagerduty-bot: NOTE: analytics: 1 paging chain, 2 PD notifications, escalation to manager suppressed after resolution.

Leah M: Postmortem owners assigned. Will sync tomorrow 09:30 PST.

incident-bot: Thread closed by Jamie C.
